query:
WITH scheduled_final_exits_2024 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id
  FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala
  WHERE person_status = 'خروج نهائي'
    AND final_exit_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31'
)

SELECT d.nationality, COUNT(*) as count
FROM scheduled_final_exits_2024 sfe
JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON sfe.id = hl.id
JOIN estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d ON sfe.id = d.id
WHERE hl.city = 'الرياض'
GROUP BY d.nationality
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 3
